alerts.description:
Using the new GoCary App, riders can access schedules, plan a trip, or find their bus using real-time bus location information.  

Finding and installing the app is a breeze!  Simply search for "GoCary" in your app store.  If you don't use a smartphone you can still access the tool online at GoCaryLive.org.

We are committed to enhancing your transit experience.  Whether you are a daily commuter or an occasional traveler, the GoCary app is your ultimate travel companion, designed to simplify your transit experience and keep you connected every step of the way.

For inquiries or further assistance, please contact us at BetterTransit@GoCary.org.
